activity.notes: The Treaty of Anagni restored the Kingdom of Majorca to James II in 1295. He ruled the restored kingdom until his death in 1311. This Activity is kept separate from his 1276–1285 reign because the Aragonese seizure was a real interruption in possession of the kingdom.

sources.title: Majorca — Encyclopedia.com
sources.citation_text: The reference states that James II began ruling Majorca in 1276, that Alfonso III seized the island in 1285, and that it remained under Aragonese rule until restoration in 1295.

sources.title: Jaume II de Mallorca — Gran Enciclopèdia Catalana
sources.citation_text: The Catalan encyclopedia identifies Jaume II as king of Mallorca, inheriting his father's Mallorcan crown in 1276 and ruling the kingdom in the late 13th and early 14th centuries.

sources.title: James II of Majorca
sources.citation_text: The compiled chronology records his restored reign from 1295 until 1311 after the Treaty of Anagni returned the Balearic kingdom.
